title: Open the intended source context
statement: As a developer, I can open or inspect a Saga against the intended source checkout so code-backed evidence is never silently resolved from a companion repository.

acceptance_criteria.statement: When the Saga is stored inside its source checkout, opening it without --repo resolves source-backed views from that checkout.
When the Saga is stored in a companion repository, opening it with --repo pointing at a matching source checkout resolves source-backed views from that checkout.
A source-backed operation refuses a checkout whose canonical repository identity differs from the Saga unless the author explicitly enables the repository-mismatch override.
